pages.notes: Plan 2 'neutralised a pin' that doesn't exist (the e7-pawn blocks the line); plan 3 secured a d4-knight that has been exchanged. Rewrote plan 2. Plan 3 is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-19 (reviewer: first draft kept the queen on d4, in the g7-bishop's line).
